{{Top|leg}}
An '''identi-lock''' was a type of [[Lock/Legends|lock]]. It could be keyed to an individual, keeping items secure. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Langstyn Kraay]] kept a cache of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in the administration dome of the [[Q'Maere Research Facility]] secured under his own identi-lock.
